newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia raises internal coffee price 0.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia raises internal coffee price 0.6 pct.

text.p: Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation increased the internal coffee price Friday 0.6 percent to 318,875 pesos per 125-kg load.

The previous price for a load set last week was 317,000 pesos. The new price, fixed on a sliding scale system introduced in January, was based on an average price of $1.91 per pound in international markets.
The sliding scale system of payments to Colombia's coffee growers was introduced to allow domestic prices to reflect more accurately prices paid for beans abroad.
